grammarItems.pattern: A + 比 + B + Vs
grammarItems.explanationEn: 比 compares two things: A is more … than B. Put the state verb straight after B. Do not add 很 or 真 (他比我很忙 is wrong); say how much more with 一點 or 多了 if you need to.

grammarItems.pattern: (S) + 太 + Vs + 了
grammarItems.explanationEn: 太…了 means 'too …' or 'so …'. It can be a complaint (太貴了) or enthusiasm (太好了), depending on the verb.

grammarItems.pattern: S + (Adv) + 能 + V (O)
grammarItems.explanationEn: 能 says something is possible in the circumstances (you have time, the weather allows it). It sits before the main verb; negate with 不能. Compare 會 for skills and 可以 for permission.

grammarItems.pattern: S + (Adv) + 會 + V (O)
grammarItems.explanationEn: This second meaning of 會 predicts what will probably happen (明天可能會下雨). It is not the 'can, know how to' meaning from book 1. Negate with 不會; 可能 and 一定 often come before it.

grammarItems.pattern: S + 給 + someone + V + O
grammarItems.explanationEn: Here 給 is a preposition: do something FOR a person (給我爸爸買禮物 = buy a gift for my dad). The person comes right after 給, then the verb.

grammarItems.pattern: 上 / 這 / 下 + 個 + 星期 / 月；去年 / 今年 / 明年
grammarItems.explanationEn: Relative time words: 上個, 這個, 下個 before 星期 or 月 give last, this and next; 去年, 今年, 明年 are last, this and next year. Time words come before the verb.
grammarItems.matcher: [上這下]個(星期|禮拜|月)|去年|今年|明年|上星期|下星期

grammarItems.pattern: S + 又 + Vs1 + 又 + Vs2
grammarItems.explanationEn: 又…又… joins two qualities that are both true: 又便宜又好吃. The two state verbs are usually both good or both bad.

grammarItems.pattern: 因為 + Clause A，所以 + Clause B
grammarItems.explanationEn: 因為 gives the reason and 所以 the result, and they usually come as a pair. The reason always comes first.

grammarItems.pattern: S + QPr + (N) + 都 + V
grammarItems.explanationEn: A question word before 都 means 'every' or, with 不, 'none': 我什麼魚都吃 (I eat any fish), 誰都不想做飯 (nobody wants to cook). The whole phrase goes before the verb.

grammarItems.pattern: S + Option A + 還是 + Option B
grammarItems.explanationEn: 還是 offers two choices in a question: 你要吃白飯還是包子？ Answer by naming the one you pick; do not answer with 嗎 or 是/不是.

grammarItems.pattern: Sentence + 吧
grammarItems.explanationEn: 吧 at the end of a sentence turns it into a gentle suggestion (我們去吧). It makes the speaker sound less direct.

grammarItems.pattern: …… 的 + (head noun)
grammarItems.explanationEn: When it is clear what the noun is, you can drop it after 的: 您要熱的還是冰的？ (hot one or iced one?). The adjective plus 的 stands in for the noun.
grammarItems.matcher: [熱冰大小貴便宜甜鹹紅杯]的(還是|[。，？！吧嗎]|$)

grammarItems.pattern: 如果 + S1 + V1，S2 + 就 + V2
grammarItems.explanationEn: 如果 sets up a condition and 就 introduces what follows from it: 如果下雨，我就不去. 就 goes before the verb (and before other adverbs) in the second clause.

grammarItems.pattern: A + 跟 + B + 一樣 (+ Vs)
grammarItems.explanationEn: A 跟 B 一樣 says A and B are the same; add a state verb to say in what way: 中文跟法文一樣難.

grammarItems.pattern: S + Vs + 了 ； S + 不 + V + 了
grammarItems.explanationEn: Sentence-final 了 marks a change: a new situation compared with before (天氣熱了, 我不喝咖啡了 = I don't drink coffee any more).

grammarItems.pattern: 雖然 + Clause, 可是 + Clause
grammarItems.explanationEn: 雖然…可是… means 'although …, still …'. The 雖然 clause comes first. Unlike English you can use both words.

grammarItems.pattern: N 塊 N 毛 N 分 (錢)
grammarItems.explanationEn: Taiwanese money: 塊 is the dollar, 毛 a tenth of it, 分 a hundredth. Say each unit in turn and end with 錢 if you like: 四十五塊六毛八分錢.
grammarItems.matcher: [0-9一二兩三四五六七八九十百]+塊|毛|分錢

grammarItems.pattern: Place A + 離 + Place B + 很 + 遠 / 近
grammarItems.explanationEn: 離 measures the distance between two places: A 離 B 很遠 (A is far from B). The distance word needs an adverb such as 很 or 不 before it.

grammarItems.pattern: 從 + Place A + 到 + Place B，……
grammarItems.explanationEn: 從…到… gives the start and end of a trip, then says how long or how far: 從我家到學校，開車要二十分鐘.

grammarItems.pattern: S + V + O，V + length of time
grammarItems.explanationEn: A length of time comes AFTER the verb. With an object, repeat the verb: 他學中文，學兩年了. Time words: 年, 個月, 個星期, 天, 個鐘頭, 分鐘.
grammarItems.matcher: (兩|三|四|五|六|七|八|九|十|一|半)(個)?(鐘頭|分鐘|小時|天|年|月)|一個月|半年

grammarItems.pattern: V / VP / Clause + 的 + N
grammarItems.explanationEn: A verb, verb phrase or whole clause can describe a noun if 的 comes between them: 住的地方 (the place where one lives), 我太太做的蛋糕 (the cake my wife made).
grammarItems.matcher: [住做買喝吃看寫說賣開穿作班學].{0,6}的(人|地方|東西|蛋糕|菜|書|衣服|房子|時候|事|蘋果|飲料|咖啡|電影|老師|朋友|學校|餐廳)

grammarItems.pattern: N + 的 + 前面 / 後面 / 旁邊 / 對面 …
grammarItems.explanationEn: Positional words (前面, 後面, 裡面, 外面, 上面, 下面, 左邊, 右邊, 旁邊, 對面) follow the place noun they relate to. 的 between them can be dropped: 學校（的）後面.
grammarItems.matcher: (前|後|裡|外|上|下)面|左邊|右邊|旁邊|對面|前邊|後邊|裡邊|外邊|樓上|樓下

grammarItems.pattern: N (place) + 在 + N + 的 + positional word
grammarItems.explanationEn: To say where a place is, put 在 and a locative phrase after it: 超級市場在餐廳對面. Ask with 在哪裡？
grammarItems.matcher: 在.+((前|後|裡|外|上|下)面|左邊|右邊|旁邊|對面|樓上|樓下)

grammarItems.pattern: (十 / 二十 …) + 幾 + MW + N
grammarItems.explanationEn: 幾 stands for any digit 1–9: 幾分鐘 is a few minutes; 十幾個人 is 11–19 people; 二十幾個 is 21–29.

grammarItems.pattern: S + 先 VP1，然後 VP2
grammarItems.explanationEn: 先…然後… orders two actions: first one, then the other. 先 comes before the first verb, 然後 starts the second part.

grammarItems.pattern: S + V + O + 了 ； S + V + 了 + Num + MW + O
grammarItems.explanationEn: 了 marks an action as completed. At the end of the sentence it reports the event (我吃早飯了). Right after the verb it goes with a counted object (我喝了三瓶啤酒), and V1了 O1，V2 O2 means 'after V1, V2'.

grammarItems.pattern: V (一) V + O
grammarItems.explanationEn: Repeating a verb (聽聽音樂) makes the action short, casual or 'a bit'. 一 can go in the middle: 看一看. Use it for relaxed activities.
grammarItems.matcher: (.)\1[音樂書電視]|看一看|(聽聽|看看|走走|玩玩|坐坐|想想|問問|試試|逛逛)

grammarItems.pattern: 多 / 少 + V + (O)
grammarItems.explanationEn: Before a verb, 多 means 'do more' and 少 'do less': 你應該多休息, 少吃一點. It is often used for advice.
grammarItems.matcher: [多少][休息喝吃睡運動看練習走注說寫買]

grammarItems.pattern: S + 沒 (有) + V + (O)
grammarItems.explanationEn: 沒(有) negates a completed action: 昨天沒來上班 (didn't come to work yesterday). Don't put 了 after the verb (not 我沒吃了飯); a 了 at the end of the sentence can still mark a change or a repeat, as in 又沒……了.

grammarItems.pattern: S + 又 + V + (O) + 了
grammarItems.explanationEn: 又…了 says something has happened again: 他又來了. It reports a repetition that has already taken place, not one that will happen.

grammarItems.pattern: S + 在 + VP + (呢)
grammarItems.explanationEn: 在 before a verb means the action is in progress right now: 他在看電視. A final 呢 can be added.
grammarItems.matcher: 在[^，。？！]{0,4}[做看吃喝寫聽說玩學洗找準想練]

grammarItems.pattern: (S) + 快 (要) + VP + 了
grammarItems.explanationEn: 快（要）…了 says something is about to happen: 我快要畢業了. Both 快 and 了 are needed.

grammarItems.pattern: S1 + 一 + VP1，S2 + 就 + VP2
grammarItems.explanationEn: 一…就… means 'as soon as …, then …': 王先生一到家，王太太就出去了. If both clauses share the subject, say it once.

grammarItems.pattern: S + V + 過 + O ； S + 沒 + V + 過 + O
grammarItems.explanationEn: 過 after a verb says you have had that experience at least once: 我看過那個電影. Negate with 沒…過 (我沒去過日本).
